name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain = class-promotion/church UI menu; descriptor accurately captures the promotion finalization step (stat-gain dialogs, spell unlock, HP/MP restore, fresh level-1 reset). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Sole caller fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main confirms it is the 'apply the promotion' tail step.
purpose: Finalize a class promotion: show the becomes-[class] dialog, roll/show the 5 per-stat gains, unlock the class's promotion spell, recalc combat stats, then reset the unit to a fresh level-1 state with full HP/MP.
logic_summary: rt_chars = runtime_char array base. growth = fd2_get_char_growth_entry(rt_chars[char_idx].portrait_id) -> new class's growth-table row (5 (min,max) byte pairs). Reload speaker portrait; set dialog sprite-id param = job_id + 0x96 and show FDTXT page 0x253 (becomes [class]) + paint portrait + clear kb. Five fd2_roll_stat_gain_and_show_message calls (AP combat_aux[0x10]/growth+0/page 0x1EA, DP combat_aux[0x12]/growth+2/page 0x1EB, DX ai_target_and_dx[1]/growth+4/page 0x1EC, HP_max/growth+6/page 0x1ED, MP_max/growth+8/page 0x1EE), threading a 4-row dialog cursor call-to-call; last return reused as spell-dialog vertical-offset base. promo_entry = fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry(portrait_id); if promo_entry[1] != 0 (class learns a spell): stash value, show FDTXT page 0x254 at row*0x17C0 + base, wait for keypress, append spell id to combat_aux[0x14]. Then fd2_recalculate_combat_stats(char_idx); fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out(); reset status_flags[0]=1 (level=1), movement_order=0 (XP-carry reset), hp_current=hp_max, mp_current=mp_max; clear keyboard buffer.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Index into the runtime_char array (data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[idx], stride 0x50) of the unit being promoted. Used everywhere as rt_chars[char_idx]. Caller fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main passes candidate_chars[cursor_idx].
params.reason: Live Ghidra param name is the generic placeholder param_1; src already uses the descriptive char_idx. It is a runtime_char array index, so char_idx is the accurate name. Rename applied in Stage 2 (touches signature/call site).

returns.semantics: No return value; all effects are in-place mutations of rt_chars[char_idx], dialog substitution globals, and on-screen dialogs.

notes: Struct offsets in the src comment verified against Ghidra runtime_char layout: pCombat_aux_block@0x27 -> combat_aux[0x10]=0x37 (AP), [0x12]=0x39 (DP); pAi_target_and_DX_block@0x3D -> [1]=0x3E (DX); wHP_max@0x42; wMP_max@0x46; bJob_id@0x20 (+0x96 sprite); pStatus_flags_block@0x21 ([0]=level); bMovement_order@0x3C; bPortrait_id@0x07 -- all match the src comment. Sole caller confirmed: fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main @ 0x31385 (call site 0x315e8), invoked at the end of the promotion flow after job_id/portrait_id written, item consumed, cinematic played. src comment block (promote.c lines 300-352) is already comprehensive, ASCII, and consistent with the Ghidra plate; no edit needed. Param threaded-cursor 4th arg is modelled int in src vs short* in raw decompile -- a Ghidra type-modelling difference, not a logic difference. (The old fd2-knowledge runtime_char map labels 0x22-0x26 as spell bitflags while Ghidra's combat_aux_block spans 0x27-0x3B; the src follows Ghidra's refined naming and logic is unchanged -- not an issue for this refine.)
